messages:
alex_support: Heads-up — OxiHealth reported repeated failed activations and dropped webhooks this morning. They hit a renewal trigger (auto-renew in 9 days) and CS flagged this as a churn risk. Raising to CS for retention/comm plan.

jordan_csm: Ack. Can you paste the error sample and the last 3 incident IDs? :eyes:

alex_support: Sure. Error shows 502 gateway on /v1/activate, retries 3x then `client_timeout`. Incident IDs: INC-92412, INC-92413, INC-92414. Quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-21T08:02:12Z ERROR webhook_handler.go:214 failed POST /v1/activate -> 502
Payload id=oxh-req-7adf, retries=3, upstream=dedicated-eu-3
```

maya_success: Thanks. Do we know if this is a specific region or route? They mentioned degraded performance on embeddings too.

sam_engineer: Looks like requests routed to eu-dedicated pool were overloaded. There was a short autoscale lag; metrics show CPU at 98% for 90s around `08:01-08:03Z`. We auto-bounced a node at 08:04.

jordan_csm: Important: renewal in 9 days. We need a two-track plan: immediate CS comms + engineering mitigation + a customer-facing status note. Can ops provide ETA and mitigation steps? @sam_engineer @alex_support

sam_engineer: Short-term: increase burst capacity + pin OxiHealth to a warm pool for the next 48h. I can request burst now (5 GPU units). Medium: adjust autoscale cooldown to 20s for this pool. Will follow up in 30m.

alex_support: I created ticket #TKT-7734 for the warm-pool request and notified infra. Also opened a Priority Support case with the account team.

maya_success: For comms, propose this cadence: 1) Immediate acknowledgement + apology email + next steps. 2) Slack/phone bridge with CSM + Engineering in 1hr. 3) Follow-up technical RCA within 48h. Need draft email and owner.

jordan_csm: I'll own the comms and run the bridge. Can someone draft the apology + technical note that is non-technical enough for the customer? Keep tone: transparent, prioritized, and solution-focused.

alex_support: Draft below — please edit: 
"Hi Samita,

We’re very sorry for the activation failures you saw this morning. Our engineering team identified transient overloads in the EU inference pool that affected a subset of activation requests. We’ve applied immediate burst capacity and are keeping your traffic on a warm pool to reduce retries. We’ll join a bridge at <time> and deliver a technical follow-up within 48 hours.

Sincerely, Redwood Support"

maya_success: Good start. Add renewal reassurance line: "We know you have an upcoming renewal; we’re prioritizing stability for your traffic and will share mitigation steps and credits if appropriate."

jordan_csm: Edited final: keep as Maya suggested + include link to quick status page. I'll send at :10.

sam_engineer: Ops update: burst capacity requested, change queued. ETA ~7min to attach warm instances. Autoscale cooldown patch will be deployed as a config change in ~2 hours, low-risk.

ops_bot: [incident] TKT-7734 status -> burst_requested_by=sam_engineer, state=queued, eta=7m

alex_support: Customer responded: "Thanks — appreciate the quick response. Please confirm the bridge time and lead points." They've accepted :10 slot.

jordan_csm: Bridge owner = jordan_csm, eng lead = sam_engineer, support = alex_support. Agenda: 1) Acknowledge + timeline 2) Current mitigation 3) Next steps + credits/renewal assurances 4) RCA & docs.

maya_success: Capture follow-up actions and owners here: 
- Send customer email (owner: jordan_csm) — sent at 08:10
- Attach warm pool (owner: sam_engineer) — ETA 08:07 (in prog)
- Update internal renewal signal (owner: maya_success) — flag account as 'at-risk' and add renewal notification to AE
- Post-incident RCA (owner: sam_engineer + alex_support) — due 48h
- Consider 1 month credit if SLA threshold violated (owner: maya_success)

alex_support: Quick note for bridge: use this short status snippet in the opening: "Transient overload caused higher error rates for some activation requests. Immediate burst capacity applied; traffic pinned to warm pool. We will follow up with RCA."

jordan_csm: All set. I’ll send the email and join the bridge. Keep channel updated with any changes. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: Warm pool attached — confirming reduced error rate in logs now. Will monitor for 30m and post metrics.

ops_bot: [incident] TKT-7734 state=attached, attached_units=5, updated_by=sam_engineer

alex_support: Monitoring shows successful activations resumed. Customer on bridge is satisfied for now but asked for confirmation on autoscale fix timeline.

maya_success: Noted — I'll add a renewal touchpoint to AE and prepare proactive credit language.

jordan_csm: Closing loop: bridge done, customer acknowledged. We'll keep this open until RCA published. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
